messages:
morgan (product): Quick internal GA note: QuantEdge family (quantedge-4b-q, quantedge-2b-slim) is GA on Hosted API today. These models are optimized for quantized kernels and lower OOMs on long-context streaming. Launch highlights: lower memory footprint, cheaper token cost for bursty workloads, and an optional edge-compat mode for low-latency regions. Rollout: us-west/eur-west first, APAC later this week. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/quantedge-ga

reza (eng-ml): Details: quantedge uses int4-int8 fused kernels and a new KV cache layout. Endpoint: POST /v2/generate with header X-RW-Model-Flavor: quantedge. Important: when using the edge-compat mode set header X-RW-Edge: 1 to engage reduced-context caching.

hana (eng-security): Policy change: publicly-shared projects that enable external tool-calls with quantized models must opt into runtime safety checks (request signing + outbound allowlist). This is to reduce risk of accidental data exfiltration via tool plugins on low-memory variants. Dedicated/private customers can request an exemption via legal.

dotbot: deploy started quantedge@stable at 2642003550 :rocket:

lee (devex): SDK snippet: 

```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(token=os.environ['RW_TOKEN'])
resp = c.generate(model='quantedge-4b-q', headers={'X-RW-Model-Flavor':'quantedge'}, stream=True)
```

Curl example: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\  
  -H "X-RW-Model-Flavor: quantedge" \\  
  -d '{"model":"quantedge-4b-q","prompt":"Summarize...","session_id":"q-7"}' \\  
  https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate
```

susan (eng-sre): Metrics/alerts: new QuantEdge dashboard added. Watch cold-starts for quantized variants; default alarm: cold-start spike > 200ms p95 for 5m. We've pre-warmed small pools to limit p95 to <120ms. Also watching model-specific error code 4512 for cache-eviction hits.

tom (docs): Migration advice uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/docs/quantedge-migrate. Note: tokenization differences are minor but can change token counts for long prompts; run small evals before flipping prod. Also added a short troubleshooting section for OOMs and fallback to non-quant models.

ana (customer-success): We'll email customers in the next 48h with a short migration checklist + invite to office hours. If teams need a runbook for Dedicated migrations, DM me.

morgan (product): Deprecation note: no immediate deprecation of existing generation endpoints. We're gating /v1/quant-preview already; full legacy preview sunset will be announced in 60 days. If you need extra time for migration or compatibility shims, open an eng-ml ticket. Thanks team :tada:
